title: Places of Redemption: Theology for a Worldly Church
subtitle: Theology for a Worldly Church
author: Mary McClintock Fulkerson
description: Fulkerson explores the role of Christian practices in overcoming segregation according to race and disability in an interracial Methodist church in the USA. She argues that theology which is truly 'worldly' must display redemption without overlooking the ambiguous and messy realities of real human lives.
